notes.title: The previous title "PSI Masquerade" has ended its service.
notes.notes: [p]The previous title [i]"PSI Masquerade"[/i] has ended its service. You can no longer log in to that version.  There is no account transfer feature, as each game is a separate, independent app. We hope you will enjoy the new [i]"PSI Masquerade Deadly Wonderland." [/i][/p][p]Occasionally, past accounts may interfere and cause account creation in this version to fail. If you encounter sign-in issues with the new game, please contact us by email.[/p]
